messages:
olivia_sales: Heads-up — Priority POC with Meridian Financial. CTO asked for an exec touchpoint tomorrow morning. Current blockers: SSO + peering certs + final pricing approval. Need a clear runbook and owners. Who can own the SSO handoff and a fallback plan if cert rotation blocks peering? :warning:

jamaal_sales: tagging ops + eng — we promised a canary tomorrow so this is time-sensitive. I can coordinate the call, but need ETA on SSO and network from infra.

aj_devx: I can do the SSO integration checklist. Do we have their IdP metadata? If not we should request it now. Also any constraints on SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows?

olivia_sales: They said SP-init only. I'll DM legal for the quick contract tweak and ask the customer to send metadata.

linh_engineering: On peering: cert rotation has been queued in infra for this week. If we wait for their CA to be added it could take 24–48h. Short-term fallback: open a temporary TLS tunnel from our dedicated subnet -> their ingress (security signoff required). I can draft the firewall snippet: ```bash
# allow from redwood-dedicated to meridian ingress
sudo iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.12.0.0/16 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```

raj_reliability: +1 on fallback, but we need an ops approval ticket and a rollback plan. If we open a tunnel, we must document traffic limits and rate limits. I'll prep a one-pager runbook and own the rollback.

ella_ps: For the exec touchpoint, customer expects: final SLA numbers, throughput targets, and cost estimate with committed vs burst pricing. Ben, can you confirm if we can present a provisional discount for a 12-month committed Dedicated plan?

ben_finance: We can offer a provisional 15% for a 12-month commit if they hit the baseline throughput >= 200 rps sustained. Need legal to approve formal wording but can present as "subject to final contract".

aj_devx: Also flag: their security questionnaire has two items unresolved — KMS key provenance and audit log retention. Security already routed those to eng-security. Link: https://redwood-internal/notes/meridian-sq (internal)

olivia_sales: Plan proposal: (1) Jamaal to schedule exec bridge (T+24h), (2) Linh + Raj to prepare fallback peering runbook and ops ticket (T+6h), (3) AJ to lead SSO checklist + request IdP metadata now (T+3h), (4) Ben to prepare provisional pricing slide (T+8h). Can everyone comment if they can hit these SLAs?

linh_engineering: I can have a runbook draft in 4h. Will include the firewall snippet and tunnel steps.

raj_reliability: Ops ticket created: OPS-5421. I'll paste runbook link into the ticket when draft is ready.

aj_devx: Request for IdP metadata sent to customer just now. If they reply within 2h I'll start SP metadata config.

ben_finance: Pricing slide in progress, will share a draft by EOD.

jamaal_sales: Scheduling exec bridge for 0900 PDT tomorrow. Invite going out imminently. Olivia, I'll own the bridge and followups. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra/cert-rotation v2.1 -> staging at 1823456800, will report status in thread.

olivia_sales: Thanks team — this is the escalation thread. I'll keep updates here. If any blocker slips beyond the runbook windows call it out immediately. :rocket:
